message.content:
To retrieve the CNAME‑record IDs for **sample.com** via VirusTotal:

1. **Get the domain’s object ID**  
   ```bash
   curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com" \
        -H "x-apikey: secret123"
   ```
   The response contains `"data": {"id": "<DOMAIN_ID>", ...}`.  
   Save `<DOMAIN_ID>`.

2. **List all subdomains of that domain**  
   ```bash
   curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/<DOMAIN_ID>/subdomains" \
        -H "x-apikey: secret123"
   ```
   The JSON payload includes an array under `"data"`; each element has `"id"` and `"attributes": {"type": "CNAME", ...}`.

3. **Filter for CNAME records and extract IDs**  
   ```python
   import json, sys
   payload = json.load(sys.stdin)          # pipe the curl output into this script
   cname_ids = [item["id"] for item in payload["data"] if item["attributes"]["type"] == "CNAME"]
   print("\n".join(cname_ids))
   ```

Running the above pipeline will output only the IDs of the CNAME records, one per line.
